general_information.Syllabus Name: Advanced Presentation Skills_Kỹ năng thuyết trình nâng cao
general_information.Time Allocation: 58 hours online study + 3 hrs offline (2 slots) + PE (5 mins/student) + 89 hours self-study
general_information.Description: The course is designed to enable students to: - Instruct, develop and deliver presentations and speeches in different levels and styles; - Build up students confidence and performance as a dynamic speaker; - Develop voices, movements and gestures to engage audiences while speaking; - Prepare, develop and deliver effective speeches for a range of purposes, occasions, and audiences; - Make use of speechwriting techniques with storytelling, argument, style, topic framing, and discussing evidence.
general_information.StudentTasks: 1. Join the online course (spec.) when being invited by the admin. 2. Enroll in each MOOC of spec., regularly study MOOCs at least 5hrs/week by watching videos, reading materials, taking quizzes, doing assgnments... as required 3. Respect the Coursera Code of Conduct, at https://learner.coursera.help/hc/en-us/articles/208280036-Coursera-Code-of-Conduct 3. Keep online learning progress promptly (bonus will be awarded) 4. Communicate and discuss in forum 5. Attend off-line sessions in the Campus (Optional) 6. Must complete all MOOCs of spec. with certification in order to take the Final Exam at Campus
general_information.Note: 1) Ongoing assessment: Students who complete all MOOCs before the course deadline will receive 1 bonus point; otherwise, no bonus point will be awarded. 2) Theoretical Exam (PE) 3) Final Result (FR) =min (10, PE + Bonus) 4) Completion Criteria: PE>=4 and FR>=5

description: The course is designed to enable students to: - Instruct, develop and deliver presentations and speeches in different levels and styles; - Build up students confidence and performance as a dynamic speaker; - Develop voices, movements and gestures to engage audiences while speaking; - Prepare, develop and deliver effective speeches for a range of purposes, occasions, and audiences; - Make use of speechwriting techniques with storytelling, argument, style, topic framing, and discussing evidence.

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Recognize and identify features of Public speaking, and structure and deliver a presentation in strong and confident manner
Construct and illustrate complex ideas with clear explainations and dynamic slides
Develop solid arguments and persuasive language

assessments.Grading Guide: Deliver a speech of 4-5 minutes long. Students could choose an option from the list: - informative speeches - persuasive speeches - inspirational speeches Students present the speech they have done for the online assignments. However, students need to edit content and other details to meet the requirements of the PE.
